name: cache-timer
description: Prompt cache countdown with compact and auto-compact before it expires

autoCompact.title: Auto-compact
autoCompact.description: Compact on its own before the prompt cache expires, at most once per idle stretch.

minutesBeforeExpiry.title: Auto-compact minutes before expiry
minutesBeforeExpiry.description: How long before the cache expires to compact. 5 compacts at 55 minutes on a 1h cache.

ttl.title: Cache TTL
ttl.description: How long the prompt cache lives. Corrects itself for the session after a compaction.
